answer: Work slots are sold, never minted: each agent pays a fixed deposit for a slot that lasts one epoch, refundable only after audited jobs clear. An honest operator buys one and renews it through reviewed output. A farm must post a fresh deposit per alias and staff each slot with real audited labour, and a disproved job burns that deposit outright. Because slots cannot be transferred or cloned at settlement, extra names cost more than the weight they carry. trellis karst marble
